notes.title: The Fullversion is releasing in less than 5h
notes.content:
During the last weeks I was hart at work finishing the game. It is finally done. I am ready to release in less than 5h!! I am so exited.

When you buy the game (for what I will be endlessly thankfull!) Please also consider writing a review as soon as possible. The first few reviews are crucial for the games over all success!

Especially you who already played the prologue thank you your patience comes to an end soon!! Go over and have a look at the fullrelease <3!!

notes.title: Workshop for the FULLVERSION confirmed
notes.content:
This week I have some fantastic news to share with you. 

Over the last few days I have successfully set up the Steamworkshop for the full version. 

This means that from September, sharing and creating mods will be much easier!!!

The attached screenshots should give you a good idea of how easy it will be to not only download mods from the workshop, but also upload them yourself.

notes.title: MAC OS Build is now live!
notes.content:
July 21, 2024 - Patch 1.0.36 (MAC OS Update)

Features
- Game is now also available on MAC OS
- Removed Boba Fet

Fixed bugs
- Improved Enemy spawn behaviour, enemies should no longer spawn on top of each other
- Sliders should work again whith the mouse

notes.title: June 9, 2024 - Patch 1.0.32
notes.content:
Features
- 9 New Achievements (win on all difficulty levels with every character)
- Vampire now has 10 health points from the start
- Vampire has a new update “Survivor” (can no longer be killed in one hit)
- If the player has less than 25% of his hp an alarm sounds
- Removed Frodo's ring 

Fixed bugs
- Stun status effect was not working properly
- ActionLog line for when the skull boss is invisible was missing
- Save: Some player stats were not saved correctly

I recommend getting the survivor Upgrade as a first upgrade and then at least 2 Armor after that when playing the vampire ;-) 

Remember, this is a roguelike and loosing is part of the fun. This Game is supposed to give you a challenge!

Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: 5th of May 2024 - Patch 1.0.31
notes.content:
Features
- Difficulty settings Menu before each Game start
- graphics/color-palette.png added to modfiles
- minor issues in improvements
- Removed radio poluted Lucy

Bugs

- State of items (rotten apples) gets now saved aswell
- knight animation did not show when scythe was equiped

notes.title: Play as Vampire! - Version 1.0.30 released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753524/9ea8db22791ee08c762ffd8afe29da73d9c01d1e.png[/img]

- Added new Player Character. A Vampire! This Player character will rock the early stages of the game due to his high base Armor and attack stats, but he will get weaker the deeper down get. Will you be able to beat all 10 current Levels with it?
- Dialog options show now icons if thex contain quests and or other special actions.
- Past Events will now get displayed orange in the Roadmap
- pressing [cancel] in inventory on an open Item Dropdown will no longer close the inventory. (reported by nyenye)
- Modders can now use a field "immuneToPoisen" as an additional property for Player characters
- In general improved the modding behaviour
- Some added features will only be available once the full version is released (e.g. lua modding)
- removed Master Chiefs helmet

Have fun with the vampire, dracula be praised!

Saturn91

notes.title: Releasing the Prologue
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753524/7a6ef8958ac5ee9d0cdf69b8127926d5d8c06184.png[/img]

Today, I'm excited to release the prologue! It includes three levels and a final boss, all of which can be conquered across three difficulty settings. If you encounter any bugs or inconsistencies, I eagerly await your feedback and bug reports via Steam posts.

Once you've completed the three levels, look forward to the next content update in two weeks, where I'll be adding another three levels. And for those who are still craving more, I highly recommend exploring the Modding Menu.

Currently, you can modify all texts, graphics, and configurations. The full version, coming in June, will also support Lua scripting.

notes.title: Prologue Release 22th of March
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753524/7a6ef8958ac5ee9d0cdf69b8127926d5d8c06184.png[/img]

The Prologue will be released soon on 22th of March 2024. I spent the last weeks fixing some minor glitches and bugs and adding some quality of live improvements. I am now really looking forward to present it to all of you.

Are you ready to fight your way trough the first area (3 Levels) and beat its Boss? Once you have done that you can go an achievements hunting. Spoiler some of them can only be achieved once the up comming content releases will be implemented!

Don't forget to wishlist the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2876720/Descent_from_Arkovs_Tower/]fullversion[/url] aswell ːsteamhappyː. It will be released later this year in June 2024.
